concerns.text: FR-004 specifies training a ≈2 M‑parameter diffusion model, while the PhysisForcing baseline uses a substantially larger model with joint physics‑informed optimization. Changing model capacity and training regime introduces a confounding variable, so the design does not isolate the effect of post‑generation filtering as the sole difference between conditions.

FR-009 allows physics‑preserving data augmentation to reach the required n ≥ 64 samples. Augmented samples are derived from existing videos, potentially violating the independence assumption required for TOST (and its non‑parametric fallback). The specification does not describe how dependence introduced by augmentation will be accounted for, risking invalid statistical inference.
